title: Vanozvininipisa Vanotsvaga Chokwadi
intro: Munyika ine simba rekare uye uroyi, panoitika kusawirirana kukuru. Rumwe rutivi rune simba rezviratidzo zvaMwari, ukuwo rumwe ruchiedza kuenzana nezvisingagoneki. Mugumisiro wacho uchachinja nhoroondo zvachose. Unogona here kufumura hunhu hweavo vakaona chokwadi chekupedzisira uye vakazvininipisa pamberi pacho?
clues: Tose takawira pasi takakotama, tisingakwanise kuramba chokwadi
Takaona kuti zviratidzo izvi zvakabva kuna Mwari Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi
Taiva nzanga yekutanga kugamuchira kutenda nenzira inoshamisa kudaro
Tambo dzedu netsvimbo zvakava nyoka pamberi pemeso edu, asi takasarudza kuzviisa pasi

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
